comment: State groupings for Gas Fundies. Production regions are state aggregates: state lines are not basin-pure (Texas holds Permian + Eagle Ford + Barnett + TX Haynesville), so basin detail comes from the Baker Hughes rig count by basin, not from production. Storage regions are EIA's weekly-report regions.

lng_feedgas_fuel_factor.comment: Feedgas estimate = LNG exports x 1.11. Liquefaction fuel and losses are roughly 10% of feedgas, so feedgas = exports / 0.90 = exports x 1.11. This is a documented modelling assumption, NOT observed data: EIA reports LNG exports, no free source reports daily or monthly feedgas by terminal.
